title: AzurSafe's premium x402-powered real-time KYT risk screening for agentic wallets
description: AzurSafe's premium x402-powered real-time KYT risk screening for agentic wallets and autonomous onchain actions. Screens blockchain wallet addresses and transaction counterparties with risk scores and decision actions across supported EVM, UTXO, Solana, XRP, Cardano, Stellar, and other major networks. Requires blockchain and address query parameters. OpenAPI spec: ai.azursafe.com/openapi.json. More details on ai.azursafe.com
